correctness.rationale: The independent uniforms convolve to a symmetric trapezoidal density; direct piecewise integration gives L_d=[(b+c-d)_+³-(b-c-d)_+³]/(24bc) for b>=c>0 with b²+c²=1 and the correct c=0 continuous limit (1-d)_+²/4. On central chamber d<=b-c, L=b/6-d/2+(1+3d²)/(12b), strictly convex in b, with stationary b_d=sqrt((1+3d²)/2). On outer chamber b-c<=d<b+c, s=b+c gives (s-d)³/[12(s²-1)], and derivative sign of s²+2ds-3, with unique stationary s_d=sqrt(d²+3)-d. Stationary points cross admissibility at q1=1/(2sqrt2), q2=1/sqrt5, q3=1/sqrt3, giving four minimum regimes. Neither chamber has an interior maximum; interface directional signs exclude an extra interface maximum. Maximum thus compares balanced to single-summand endpoints, crossing once at delta approximately .47177505; all-zero boundary for d>=sqrt2, and all orientations with b+c<=d minimize for d>=1. Independent dense orientation grids at 14 strikes, including all three transitions and d=1,sqrt2, reproduced the exact extrema to <1e-6; analytic derivative sign completes continuum proof.
